title: team-sync room config (schema 1)
description: One file per writer at rooms/<room>/config/<writer-id>.json on the team-sync branch. Only its own writer (the agent id, or the owner slug for a non-joined human) writes it. The effective value of a key across the whole room is the entry with the highest (clock, at, writer); null means unset.

writer.description: agent id, or owner slug for a non-joined human

rev.description: bumped on every save; orders versions in merges

seq.description: counter for this writer's rule ids (rule.<writer>.r<n>)

fields.description: key -> field entry. Keys: title, description, goal; rule.<writer>.r<n>; policy.<name> (allowlisted); or a custom field matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$.

value.description: the field's value; null means this key was unset by this writer

clock.description: Lamport clock: 1 + the highest clock seen for this key across every writer file at the time of the write
